content.title: Fatburger Owner Is the Latest Casual-Dining Bankruptcy
content.summary: The company has around $1.45 billion of funded debt obligations outstanding, according to a court filing from FAT Brands’ chief restructuring officer dated Jan. 27.  The step came after FAT Brands didn’t make interest payments due in October on some of its $1.2 billion in whole-business securitization debt.
